title: Phantom Blade Zero Wins Push Square's October 2026 Game of the Month Ahead of GTA 6
description: As the month before GTA 6, October 2026 was packed with PS5 releases. Push Square readers voted Phantom Blade Zero as Game of the Month.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Month Before GTA 6: A Busy Period for PS5

October is a month that carries a special weight for the gaming community, perfectly described by media outlet Push Square as simply "the month before GTA 6." Following an equally manic September, the past 31 days proved to be an incredibly busy period for new PS5 releases, making the latest Game of the Month poll all the more intriguing.

With so many titles vying for attention during this critical window leading up to Rockstar's massive upcoming release, the competition on Sony's console was fiercer than ever.

## Phantom Blade Zero Takes the Crown

According to the community votes hosted by Push Square, it was *Phantom Blade Zero* that captured the hearts and minds of players to claim the Game of the Month title for October 2026.

While the industry's collective gaze is increasingly fixed on the horizon of GTA 6, this poll victory highlights the enduring appetite that PS5 owners have for compelling new experiences, proving that standout releases can still command the spotlight even on the eve of a generational blockbusting launch.

## Editor's Take

Navigating the release calendar right before a cultural phenomenon like GTA 6 is no easy task for any developer. Yet, *Phantom Blade Zero* managing to secure Push Square's October Game of the Month through community votes speaks volumes about its quality and the players' eagerness for top-tier action.
